class.name: SteamDevice
class.brief_description: Reads Steam device and VR state and opens Steam text input.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.device] after starting a Steam client. Query it on the main thread. Use the preset as a hint for initial settings and keep the player's saved choices. Steam reports platform state and accepts dashboard and keyboard requests. Use Godot's OpenXR interface for headset rendering, tracked input, and XR session lifecycle.

method.name: dismiss_keyboard
method.description: Request dismissal of this scope's current Steam keyboard. [constant OK] means the request was accepted. The keyboard remains reserved until Steam reports it closed. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when there is no keyboard and [constant ERR_BUSY] when another scope owns it or a prior owner is closing.

method.name: enter_text
method.description: Open the modal Steam keyboard in the active rendered window. Await a [SteamTextEntryResult]. The optional prompt is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes and [param max_chars] to 1 through 4096 Unicode characters. Initial text must fit the requested length. Hidden mode masks characters during entry. A user dismissal succeeds with an empty, unsubmitted entry. Return an unavailable result if Steam cannot open the dialog or the owning scope stops, or [constant ERR_BUSY] if a keyboard is already active or closing.

method.name: hardware
method.description: Returns the hardware family Steam reports for this game, or [constant HARDWARE_UNKNOWN] if the query is unavailable or the reported value is unrecognized.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether this exact client start can query Steam Utils on the main thread. Some individual queries depend on additional SDK exports.

method.name: is_headset_streaming_enabled
method.description: Returns whether Steam reports that the headset view is streaming over Steam Remote Play. Returns [code]false[/code] if the query is unavailable.

method.name: is_proton
method.description: Returns whether Steam reports that the game process is running under Proton. Returns [code]false[/code] if the query is unavailable.

method.name: is_running_in_vr
method.description: Returns whether Steam itself reports running in VR mode. Returns [code]false[/code] if the query is unavailable. Query the OpenXR interface for the game's own XR session state.

method.name: is_steam_deck
method.description: Returns whether [method hardware] identifies a Steam Deck.

method.name: open_vr_dashboard
method.description: Asks Steam to open its VR dashboard. [constant OK] acknowledges the SDK request. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when Steam is outside VR mode or the scope or dashboard capability is unavailable.

method.name: recommended_preset
method.description: Returns Steam's recommended starting configuration for this game and hardware. [constant PRESET_NONE] means Steam has no suggestion. [constant PRESET_UNKNOWN] means the query is unavailable or the value is unrecognized.

method.name: show_keyboard_for
method.description: Open Steam's floating keyboard beside a visible, focused, editable [LineEdit] or [TextEdit] in the main game window. The field's bounds are transformed to client pixels. Steam sends OS key events to the focused control. Crimson requests dismissal if the field loses focus, becomes hidden or read-only, or leaves the tree. The field keeps its normal Godot text and submit behavior. Return [constant ERR_BUSY] while any scope's Steam keyboard is active or closing.

signal.name: keyboard_dismissed
signal.description: Emitted when Steam confirms that the floating keyboard owned by this live scope closed. Await [method enter_text] for the separate modal result.
